title: Zesty Braised Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A salty and flaky Kenyan dish featuring lamb, blueberries, and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection on a cedar plank. This meal prep friendly stew is also anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a cedar plank, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Add the blueberries to the lamb mixture and stir gently to combine.
Cover the cedar plank with aluminum foil and braise the stew for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue braising for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh blueberries and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
